name: Hitsssh
author: victor3232
description:
HITSSSH - all-in-one ringan: Node.js + Python + Cloudflare Tunnel dalam satu egg.
Node.js dan Python punya pilihan versi sendiri di Variables (tanpa ganti image).
Cloudflare Tunnel tinggal isi CF_TOKEN dan set ENABLE_CF_TUNNEL=true.
Startup command auto-detect (package.json / main.py / app.py / bot.py) atau isi STARTUP_CMD manual.
Tanpa Go, Bun, Playwright, ffmpeg, dan tool lain yang tidak perlu.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
#  HITSSSH Installer
#  Node.js + Python + Cloudflare Tunnel (1 egg, ringan)
# ============================================================
set -o pipefail

echo "=========================================="
echo "              H I T S S S H               "
echo "=========================================="

RUNTIME="/mnt/server/.runtime"
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
echo "[install] Menyiapkan paket dasar..."
apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates tar xz-utils git jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64|amd64)  NODE_ARCH="x64";  CF_ARCH="amd64" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) NODE_ARCH="arm64"; CF_ARCH="arm64" ;;
  *) echo "[install] ERROR: arsitektur $(uname -m) tidak didukung."; exit 1 ;;
esac

# ---------------- Git clone (opsional) ----------------
if [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "[install] User upload mode: git clone dilewati."
elif [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
  ADDR="$GIT_ADDRESS"
  case "$ADDR" in
    *.git) ;;
    *) ADDR="${ADDR}.git" ;;
  esac

  if [ -n "${USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    ADDR="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo "$ADDR" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
  fi

  if [ -d /mnt/server/.git ]; then
    echo "[install] Repo sudah ada, menjalankan git pull..."
    git -C /mnt/server pull --ff-only || echo "[install] WARNING: git pull gagal, file lama dipakai."
  elif [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\.runtime$')" ]; then
    echo "[install] Cloning repo..."
    if [ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]; then
      git clone --single-branch --branch "$BRANCH" "$ADDR" /mnt/server || exit 1
    else
      git clone "$ADDR" /mnt/server || exit 1
    fi
  else
    echo "[install] Folder server tidak kosong dan bukan repo git, clone dilewati."
  fi
else
  echo "[install] GIT_ADDRESS kosong: lewati clone (upload manual / file manager)."
fi

mkdir -p "$RUNTIME/bin" "$RUNTIME/node"

# ---------------- Node.js (opsional) ----------------
if [ -n "${NODE_VERSION:-}" ]; then
  NV="${NODE_VERSION#v}"

  if [ "$NV" = "lts" ]; then
    FULL=$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | jq -r '[.[] | select(.lts != false)][0].version' 2>/dev/null)
  elif echo "$NV" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$'; then
    FULL=$(curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v${NV}.x/" \
      | grep -oE "node-v${NV}\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-linux-${NODE_ARCH}\.tar\.xz" \
      | head -n1 \
      | sed -E 's/^node-(v[0-9.]+)-linux.*/\1/')
  else
    FULL="v${NV}"
  fi

  case "$FULL" in
    v[0-9]*) ;;
    *) echo "[install] ERROR: Node.js versi '${NODE_VERSION}' tidak ditemukan."; exit 1 ;;
  esac

  echo "[install] Mengunduh Node.js ${FULL} (linux-${NODE_ARCH})..."
  rm -rf "$RUNTIME/node"
  mkdir -p "$RUNTIME/node"
  curl -fL --retry 3 "https://nodejs.org/dist/${FULL}/node-${FULL}-linux-${NODE_ARCH}.tar.xz" -o /tmp/node.tar.xz || exit 1
  tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C "$RUNTIME/node" --strip-components=1 || exit 1
  rm -f /tmp/node.tar.xz

  if [ -x "$RUNTIME/node/bin/node" ]; then
    echo "[install] Node.js siap: $("$RUNTIME/node/bin/node" -v)"
  else
    echo "[install] ERROR: Node.js gagal diekstrak."; exit 1
  fi
else
  echo "[install] NODE_VERSION kosong: Node.js dilewati (mode Python only)."
fi

# ---------------- Python (versi pilihan) ----------------
if [ -n "${PYTHON_VERSION:-}" ]; then
  case "$PYTHON_VERSION" in
    3.10) PY_TAG="20261009"; PY_VER="3.10.22" ;;
    3.11) PY_TAG="20261110"; PY_VER="3.11.18" ;;
    3.12) PY_TAG="20261110"; PY_VER="3.12.16" ;;
    3.13) PY_TAG="20261110"; PY_VER="3.13.18" ;;
    3.14) PY_TAG="20261110"; PY_VER="3.14.10" ;;
    *) echo "[install] ERROR: PYTHON_VERSION harus 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, atau 3.14."; exit 1 ;;
  esac

  if [ "$NODE_ARCH" = "x64" ]; then PY_ARCH="x86_64"; else PY_ARCH="aarch64"; fi
  PY_URL="https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/download/${PY_TAG}/cpython-${PY_VER}%2B${PY_TAG}-${PY_ARCH}-unknown-linux-gnu-install_only_stripped.tar.gz"

  echo "[install] Mengunduh Python ${PY_VER} (${PY_ARCH})..."
  rm -rf "$RUNTIME/python"
  mkdir -p "$RUNTIME/python"
  curl -fL --retry 3 "$PY_URL" -o /tmp/python.tar.gz || exit 1
  tar -xzf /tmp/python.tar.gz -C "$RUNTIME/python" --strip-components=1 || exit 1
  rm -f /tmp/python.tar.gz

  if [ -x "$RUNTIME/python/bin/python3" ]; then
    [ -e "$RUNTIME/python/bin/python" ] || ln -sf python3 "$RUNTIME/python/bin/python"
    echo "[install] Python siap: $("$RUNTIME/python/bin/python3" --version)"
  else
    echo "[install] ERROR: Python gagal diekstrak."; exit 1
  fi
else
  echo "[install] PYTHON_VERSION kosong: pakai Python bawaan image."
fi

# ---------------- cloudflared ----------------
if command -v cloudflared >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[install] cloudflared sudah tersedia di image."
else
  echo "[install] Mengunduh cloudflared (linux-${CF_ARCH})..."
  if curl -fL --retry 3 "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-${CF_ARCH}" -o "$RUNTIME/bin/cloudflared"; then
    chmod +x "$RUNTIME/bin/cloudflared"
    "$RUNTIME/bin/cloudflared" --version || true
  else
    rm -f "$RUNTIME/bin/cloudflared"
    echo "[install] WARNING: cloudflared gagal diunduh, akan pakai cloudflared dari image (jika ada)."
  fi
fi

# ---------------- start.sh ----------------
cat > "$RUNTIME/start.sh" <<'STARTEOF'
#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
#  HITSSSH - start script (auto-generated oleh installer)
#  Node.js + Python + Cloudflare Tunnel
# ============================================================
cd /home/container 2>/dev/null || cd /mnt/server || exit 1

export PATH="/mnt/server/.runtime/python/bin:/mnt/server/.runtime/node/bin:/mnt/server/.runtime/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"
export NODE_PATH="/mnt/server/.runtime/node/lib/node_modules"

# ---------------- Cloudflare Tunnel ----------------
if [ "${ENABLE_CF_TUNNEL:-false}" = "true" ] || [ "${ENABLE_CF_TUNNEL:-false}" = "1" ]; then
  if [ -n "${CF_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    CF_BIN=""
    if [ -x /mnt/server/.runtime/bin/cloudflared ]; then
      CF_BIN="/mnt/server/.runtime/bin/cloudflared"
    else
      CF_BIN="$(command -v cloudflared 2>/dev/null || true)"
    fi

    if [ -n "$CF_BIN" ]; then
      pkill -x cloudflared 2>/dev/null || true
      nohup "$CF_BIN" tunnel run --token "$CF_TOKEN" \
        > /home/container/.cloudflared.log 2>&1 &
      echo "[startup] Cloudflare Tunnel aktif (log: .cloudflared.log)"
    else
      echo "[startup] ERROR: cloudflared tidak ditemukan, reinstall server."
    fi
  else
    echo "[startup] WARNING: ENABLE_CF_TUNNEL aktif tapi CF_TOKEN kosong."
  fi
fi

PY="python"
command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 || PY="python3"

# ---------------- Auto-install dependency (sekali saja) ----------------
if [ "${AUTO_INSTALL_DEPS:-true}" = "true" ] || [ "${AUTO_INSTALL_DEPS:-true}" = "1" ]; then
  if [ -f package.json ] && command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    NPM_MARK="/mnt/server/.runtime/.npm-$(md5sum package.json | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ ! -f "$NPM_MARK" ]; then
      echo "[startup] Menjalankan npm install..."
      npm install --no-audit --no-fund && mkdir -p node_modules && touch "$NPM_MARK"
    fi
  fi

  if [ -f requirements.txt ] && command -v "$PY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PYVER=$("$PY" -c 'import sys; print("%d.%d" % sys.version_info[:2])' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
    PIP_MARK="/mnt/server/.runtime/.pip-${PYVER}-$(md5sum requirements.txt | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    if [ ! -f "$PIP_MARK" ]; then
      echo "[startup] Menjalankan pip install --user -r requirements.txt..."
      PIP_FLAGS="--user"
      "$PY" -m pip install --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- "--break-system-packages" && PIP_FLAGS="$PIP_FLAGS --break-system-packages"
      "$PY" -m pip install $PIP_FLAGS -r requirements.txt && touch "$PIP_MARK"
    fi
  fi
fi

# ---------------- Pilih perintah start ----------------
CMD="${STARTUP_CMD:-}"

if [ -z "$CMD" ]; then
  if [ -f package.json ] && [ -f index.js ]; then
    CMD="node index.js"
  elif [ -f package.json ]; then
    CMD="npm start"
  elif [ -f main.py ]; then
    CMD="$PY main.py"
  elif [ -f app.py ]; then
    CMD="$PY app.py"
  elif [ -f bot.py ]; then
    CMD="$PY bot.py"
  fi
  [ -n "$CMD" ] && echo "[startup] Auto-detect: $CMD"
fi

echo "=========================================="
echo "               H I T S S S H              "
echo " Node.js : $(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo '-')"
echo " Python  : $("$PY" --version 2>&1 | awk '{print $2}')"
echo "=========================================="
echo "System Ready."

if [ -n "$CMD" ]; then
  exec bash -c "$CMD"
else
  echo "[startup] Tidak ada app terdeteksi & STARTUP_CMD kosong: masuk mode shell."
  exec bash
fi
STARTEOF
chmod +x "$RUNTIME/start.sh"

echo "[install] Selesai. Runtime: $(du -sh "$RUNTIME" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
exit 0

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description:
Perintah untuk menjalankan aplikasi. Kosongkan untuk auto-detect:
- package.json + index.js -> node index.js
- package.json saja -> npm start
- main.py / app.py / bot.py -> python <file>
Contoh manual: node index.js | python main.py | npm start | python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python main.py

variables.name: Python Version
variables.description: Versi Python yang dipakai: 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, atau 3.14 (di-install otomatis saat install server). Kosongkan untuk memakai Python bawaan image (3.12). Ganti versi = Reinstall server.

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: Versi Node.js yang di-install saat install server: 18, 20, 22, 24, atau lts. Boleh juga versi lengkap (22.11.0). Kosongkan jika hanya butuh Python (hemat ±110 MB).

variables.name: Auto Install Dependencies
variables.description: Otomatis jalankan 'npm install' jika ada package.json dan 'pip install --user -r requirements.txt' jika ada requirements.txt. Hanya dijalankan sekali (di-cache), jadi tidak memperlambat start berikutnya.

variables.name: Aktifkan Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: Set 'true' atau '1' untuk menyalakan Cloudflare Tunnel saat server start.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Token tunnel dari Cloudflare Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels. Wajib jika tunnel diaktifkan.

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: URL repo untuk auto-clone saat install (opsional). Contoh: https://github.com/user/repo

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch yang di-clone. Kosongkan untuk branch default repo.

variables.name: Uploaded Files
variables.description: Set '1' jika file di-upload manual lewat File Manager (git clone dilewati).

variables.name: GIT ACCESS TOKEN
variables.description: Personal Access Token untuk repo private (opsional).
